metrics.description: Accepted user chat sends per local day, across current and legacy chat routes. This counts sends rather than responses or completed runs.
Accepted user workflow launches per local day. Launch acceptance does not establish successful completion or provider usage.
Percentage of observed setup snapshots with profile, crew and job readiness, per local day. Repeated observations count separately; this is a readiness proxy rather than validated activation.
Failed deliberate UI requests divided by non-aborted observed requests, per local day. HTTP, network and invalid-response failures count; polling and streams are excluded.
95th percentile elapsed duration of successful deliberate UI requests, per local day. Only valid measured durations count; empty groups have no measurement.
Failed observed runs divided by all observed terminal runs, per local day and mode. Cancellations remain in the denominator; closed-renderer and historical runs are excluded.
95th percentile valid observed run duration, per local day and mode. Missing durations remain unmeasured; routines and follow-ups may contribute observations.
Reviewed sanitized renderer exception observations per local day. Deduplication and rate limits apply; daemon crashes and provider internals are outside coverage.
Successful imported completed CI attempts divided by all imported completed attempts, per local day. Cancellations, skips and repeat attempts remain in the denominator.
Imported merged non-bot PR count per local day and target branch. Counts completed merges, with no developer ranking or native Engineering Analytics source claim.
95th percentile imported PR opening-to-merge elapsed hours per local day and target branch. Former draft and waiting time are included; this is not review time or DORA cycle time.
